seo.title: Pricing | VoiceBridge Pro
seo.description: VoiceBridge Pro gives every account a free 3-day trial with limited access. See what's included, and the one-time fee that unlocks full access afterward.

hero.title: Simple, honest pricing
hero.intro: Every account starts with 3 days of limited access, completely free — no card required. A single one-time fee then unlocks full access, unlimited profiles, and advanced features.

free.title: Free Trial
free.description: Limited access to try VoiceBridge Pro, no card required.
features: Personalised communication board with visual cards
Limited access for free trial — starts the moment you register
free.note: No credit card needed to start. After 3 days, upgrade with the one-time fee below to keep your account — and your child's board — active.
limitations: Access pauses after 3 days until you upgrade

instant.title: Full Access
instant.description: Unlock full access for good, with unlimited profiles and advanced features.
features: Pay any time — during your trial or after it ends
instant.note: This fee also helps support VoiceBridge Pro's ongoing development. See our Refunds & Cancellations policy for details.

items.question: Is VoiceBridge Pro really free?
items.answer: Yes — every account gets 3 days of limited access at no cost, no card required. After that, a one-time ₹499 payment unlocks full access, unlimited profiles, and advanced features.

items.question: What happens when my 3-day trial ends?
items.answer: Access pauses — including your child's communication board — until you upgrade. Nothing is charged automatically. You can pay any time, before or after your trial ends, and it's a one-time fee, not a subscription.

items.question: Will there be paid subscriptions in future?
items.answer: We may introduce optional premium features for therapy centers in the future. If we do, pricing and terms will be clearly listed here before launch.
